about_the_game:
Reaching the gates will not be easy... You must overcome the obstacles you encounter at every step and resist the increasingly stronger enemies.

Gameplay Summary

Use Your Intelligence, Overcome Obstacles Make quick decisions and race against time when defeating enemies. Every second is precious; if you delay, more difficult enemies will appear again.

  • Tackle Elite Enemies Be prepared for the powerful enemies waiting for you at the transition points. Defeating them is the key to advancing to the next level!

  • Survival Challenge Gather your hit points, use your special abilities. Use ranged attacks to neutralize enemies and gain the advantage.

  • Hazardous Environments and Platforms Moving floors, deadly traps and areas full of mechanics that require attention are waiting for you.

  • Use your time preciously As you lose time, enemies respawn. Be quick and decisive!

  • Health and Stamina Skill System Your Health Points slowly recharge, while your Stamina points allow you to use special abilities. Abilities recharge infinitely over time.

  • Regional dynamics In each area, enemies become more aggressive and obstacles become more difficult. It is essential to proceed strategically and carefully!

short_description: Awurda First Wave - Speed, Strategy and Unlimited Action! invites you to the heart of the action with its fast-paced gameplay and engaging combat mechanics! Test your speed, wits and reflexes to survive in arenas filled with elite enemies.
